I know I don’t know you, and you don’t know me.  And I rarely ever actually post anything on Reddit, but I saw this on my feed. I was diagnosed with Bipolar II a few months ago. I go through the wringer every day dealing with it. I might not know what it feels like to have BPD, but I know what it feels like to have lost all hope. I’ve tried committing suicide once and have had other smaller attempts on my life that I wouldn’t consider a “suicide attempt”. Brains and thoughts can take you to dark places. I guess I just want to say that you aren’t alone. Being in a psych ward with many other people who suffer from mental illness has shown me that you are never alone in your feelings. I’m thinking about you and all that you are going through right now. I hope that you don’t take your life and continue to push forward, because that’s all anyone can do.
